notes: Published facts with no cat6 or compat2 field, kept verbatim rather than dropped; all from source.cat6.gigabyte.b650m-aorus-elite-ax-rev-1-3.spec. Revision: this SKU is the Rev. 1.3 board and its figures come from the Rev. 1.3 specification page. GIGABYTE publishes revision-specific pages under one model name, so figures from the 1.0/1.1, 1.2 or 1.4 pages do not transfer here; the revision is carried in both the id and modelName for that reason. Memory: 4 DIMM sockets, maximum capacity 256GB, AMD EXPO and Intel XMP supported. maxMemorySpeedMtS records DDR5-8000(OC), the highest rate the vendor explicitly lists for this SKU, per C14. BIOS: biosMinVersionForCpu is deliberately empty under O6. Board dimensions: the page publishes '24.4cm x 24.4cm', a two-figure board outline with no thickness, and cat6's DimensionsMm requires all three, so dimensionsMm is absent rather than completed with a guessed figure.
